prompt: Create a delicate close-up fantasy portrait of an elegant young woman in a three-dimensional layered watercolor paper art style. The composition is vertical, cropped tightly around the face and shoulders, with her face centered slightly right, looking directly at the viewer with large luminous sapphire blue eyes, long lashes, soft pink lips, porcelain skin, and a calm gentle smile. Her silvery ash-brown hair is wispy and windblown, with fine strands sweeping across the left side of the image. Surround her with exactly 6 prominent paper-cut floral elements: 1 large blue-and-white flower forming a dramatic hat-like crown at the top, 1 white rose-like bloom in the upper right, 1 purple-and-white flower near the right cheek, 1 pale violet flower cluster behind the left shoulder, 1 white blossom with golden stamens near the lower left shoulder, and 1 small white rose cluster on the lower left. Add torn, curled strips of layered watercolor paper wrapping diagonally around her head and shoulders, colored in indigo, periwinkle, white, translucent gray, and metallic gold-speckled beige. Emphasize tactile paper texture: torn deckled edges, folded petals, layered cutouts, raised shadows, fibrous watercolor paper grain, and subtle sparkling pigment. Use a soft high-key white background with faint lavender and blue washes, airy bokeh, tiny white speckles, and gentle diffused light from the upper left. Visual style should blend elegant anime-inspired beauty illustration, realistic watercolor, paper sculpture collage, and luminous editorial portrait art. Keep the palette cool and refined with cobalt blue, soft violet, pearl white, warm beige gold, and pale skin tones. No text, no watermark, no harsh outlines, no extra characters.

promptZh: 创作一张精致的特写奇幻肖像，主角为 一位优雅的年轻女性，采用三维层叠水彩纸艺风格。构图为竖向，紧凑地截取面部和肩部，面部略微偏右居中，直视镜头，拥有明亮动人的 蓝宝石色 双眸、长睫毛、柔和的粉色嘴唇、瓷器般的肌肤以及平静温柔的微笑。她的 银灰棕色 发丝轻盈且随风飘动，细碎的发丝掠过画面左侧。周围环绕着 6 朵醒目的剪纸花卉元素：顶部有一朵巨大的蓝白花朵形成戏剧性的帽状冠冕，右上角有一朵白色玫瑰状花朵，右脸颊附近有一朵紫白相间的花朵，左肩后方有一簇淡紫色的花朵，左下肩附近有一朵带有金色花蕊的白色花朵，左下方有一簇小白玫瑰。添加撕裂、卷曲的层叠水彩纸条，呈对角线环绕在她的头部和肩部，颜色包括靛蓝、长春花蓝、白色、半透明灰色以及带有金属金色斑点的米色。强调纸张的触感：撕裂的毛边、折叠的花瓣、层叠的剪纸、凸起的阴影、纤维感的水彩纸纹理以及细微的闪光颜料。使用柔和的高调白色背景，带有淡淡的薰衣草色和蓝色晕染、轻盈的虚化效果、细小的白色斑点，以及来自左上方的柔和漫射光。视觉风格应融合优雅的动漫风格美学插画、写实水彩、纸雕拼贴和明亮的编辑肖像艺术。色调保持冷色调且精致，使用 钴蓝色、柔和的紫罗兰色、珍珠白、温暖的米金色和浅肤色。无文字，无水印，无生硬轮廓，无额外角色。
